## Dead Sea Scrolls Manuscripts

:::::: columns
:::: {.column .fragment width="50%"}
Example: Dead Sea Scrolls manuscripts

::: incremental
- Data: catalog of Dead Sea Scrolls manuscripts
- Question: which works have the most manuscripts?
- Finding: 1 Enoch has as many manuscripts as Genesis (24 each)
:::
::::

::: {.column .fragment width="50%"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)

tt <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load(2026, week = 37)
dead_sea_scrolls <- tt$dead_sea_scrolls

book_counts <- dead_sea_scrolls |>
  filter(!is.na(biblical_book)) |>
  count(biblical_book, canon_status, name = "n_manuscripts", sort = TRUE)

book_counts |>
  filter(n_manuscripts >= 16) |>
  mutate(biblical_book = fct_reorder(biblical_book, n_manuscripts)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n_manuscripts, y = biblical_book)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Number of manuscripts", y = NULL)
```
:::
